 "data": "---
config:
 theme: base
 htmlLabels: false
 fontFamily: Arial, sans-serif
 themeVariables:
 fontFamily: Arial, sans-serif
 fontSize: 18px
 primaryColor: '#f8fafc'
 primaryTextColor: '#233849'
 primaryBorderColor: '#9aabb7'
 lineColor: '#000000'

 clusterBorder: '#d6e0e6'
 edgeLabelBackground: '#ffffff'

 curve: linear
 nodeSpacing: 8
 rankSpacing: 12

 top: 5
 bottom: 20
 padding: 8
 diagramPadding: 24
---
flowchart TB
 FILE[\"File bitstream · MSB-first<br/>679,016 bit\"]:::payload

 subgraph SPLIT[\"1 Split into 340 chunks\"]
 direction LR
 S0[\"Chunk 0<br/>2,000 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ S1[\"Chunk 1<br/>2,000 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ DOTS[\"· · ·\"]:::plain ~~~ S339[\"Chunk 339<br/>1,016 bit\"]:::payload
 end

 subgraph PAD[\"2 Pad the final chunk to 2,000 bit\"]
 direction LR
 LAST[\"File data<br/>1,016 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ ZEROS[\"Zero padding<br/>984 bit\"]:::padding
 end

 DISABLED[\"LDPC disabled\"]:::neutral
 SCRAMBLE[\"PCG64 scrambling · each 2,000-bit chunk<br/>seed = 42 + chunk index\"]:::process

 subgraph CRC[\"3 Insert CRC32 after each 500-bit scrambled segment\"]
 direction LR
 D1[\"Data<br/>500 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ C1[\"CRC32<br/>32 bit\"]:::checksum ~~~ D2[\"Data<br/>500 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ C2[\"CRC32<br/>32 bit\"]:::checksum ~~~ D3[\"Data<br/>500 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ C3[\"CRC32<br/>32 bit\"]:::checksum ~~~ D4[\"Data<br/>500 bit\"]:::payload ~~~ C4[\"CRC32<br/>32 bit\"]:::checksum
 end

 GRAPH[\"De Bruijn graph encoding<br/>2,128 bit → one DNA payload per chunk\"]:::dna

 subgraph FINAL[\"4 Add indexes and protection to each DNA sequence\"]
 direction LR
 FL5[\"Flank<br/>200 nt\"]:::flank ~~~ PA5[\"polyA<br/>10 nt\"]:::marker ~~~ IX5[\"5′ index<br/>15 nt\"]:::barcode ~~~ PAY[\"DNA payload<br/>2,540–2,796 nt\"]:::dna ~~~ IX3[\"3′ index<br/>15 nt\"]:::barcode ~~~ PA3[\"polyA<br/>10 nt\"]:::marker ~~~ FL3[\"Flank<br/>200 nt\"]:::flank
 end

 OUTPUT[\"340 indexed DNA sequences · 2,990–3,246 nt\"]:::output
 NOTE[\"All 340 chunks follow the same downstream steps.<br/>Segment widths are schematic, not to scale.\"]:::plain

 FILE --> SPLIT
 SPLIT -->|\"enlarge final chunk\"| PAD
 PAD --> DISABLED --> SCRAMBLE --> CRC --> GRAPH --> FINAL --> OUTPUT
 OUTPUT ~~~ NOTE
